# RentIntel

> Smart rental property analyzer with ROI projections, Monte Carlo simulations, ZIP-level rent lookups, tax insights, and side-by-side deal comparison.

RentIntel helps real estate investors evaluate rental deals using institutional-grade tools — all client-side, no signup required.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, features, and competitor comparison.
- [ZIP Rent Lookup](/): Live area insights, rent estimates, demographics, and Street View for any address.
- [Deal Analyzer](/): ROI, Cap Rate, Cash Flow, Deal Score, break-even, and tenant affordability.
- [ROI & Taxes](/): Multi-year ROI with depreciation and tax savings.
- [Comparison](/): Side-by-side analysis of multiple properties.
- [Advanced Tools](/): Monte Carlo simulations and scenario modeling.
- [Help & Legal](/): Financial glossary, methodology, and disclaimers.
